title: Dana Whitfield: three unconfirmed beneficiary readbacks hit the re-ask cap -> ESCALATE (hand-built)
description: Hand-built (label: hand-built) from the same live incident as readback-bare-restatement-confirms.json (scripts/rehearse/reports/2026-09-11T22-51-38-barge-in-interrupt.md, deploy 20): the agent read back the beneficiary ("Just to confirm, the beneficiary is Meridian Supply. Is that correct?") repeatedly while the caller kept answering without ever confirming or negating it, until the 60s idle timeout escalated via row 14/15. That specific live cause (a bare exact restatement hitting neither lexicon) was fixed by the ledger.ts restatement fix (main, 4fe3345) -- but nothing bounded a caller who answers with something that is NEITHER a confirmation NOR a restatement, for example "Hold on." every time. This fixture is otherwise identical to readback-bare-restatement-confirms.json (same identity, tools, live checks, TRAP_FACT challenge, amount/account readback+confirm) through the account readback; the beneficiary readback is then answered "Hold on." three times running (r3/r4/r5, all field beneficiary, none affirm/negate/restatement), reaching seed.thresholds.max_readback_reasks (3) while beneficiary stays unconfirmed. Founder decision 2026-09-12 9:00 AM: cap readback re-asks at 3, then escalate to a human -- proves the new row (sits where the old row 13 sat; FREEZE still wins ahead of it) fires ESCALATE naming the field, instead of holding at row 5 forever.
